{"content":"## Creating a Google Cloud Compute Engine Instance with an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS

Below are two ways to create the instance:

1. **Using the `gcloud` CLI**
2. **Using the REST API (curl)**

Both methods assume you have already enabled the Compute Engine API, set your project ID, and authenticated with the appropriate scopes.

---

### 1. Using the `gcloud` CLI

```bash
# Set variables
PROJECT_ID="your-project-id"
ZONE="us-central1-a"          # choose a zone that supports GPUs
MACHINE_TYPE="n1-standard-8"  # adjust CPU/RAM as needed
GPU_COUNT=1
GPU_TYPE="nvidia-tesla-a6000"
IMAGE_FAMILY="ubuntu-2004-lts"
IMAGE_PROJECT="ubuntu-os-cloud"
INSTANCE_NAME="rtx-a6000-ubuntu"

# Create the instance
gcloud compute instances create $INSTANCE_NAME \
  --project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --zone=$ZONE \
  --machine-type=$MACHINE_TYPE \
  --accelerator=type=$GPU_TYPE,count=$GPU_COUNT \
  --image-family=$IMAGE_FAMILY \
  --image-project=$IMAGE_PROJECT \
  --boot-disk-size=100GB \
  --boot-disk-type=pd-ssd \
  --tags=http-server,https-server \
  --metadata-from-file startup-script=startup.sh \
  --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
```

> **Notes**
> - Replace `your-project-id` with your actual GCP project ID.
> - The `--tags` flag exposes HTTP/HTTPS ports if you plan to run a web server.
> - The `--metadata-from-file startup-script=startup.sh` is optional; you can omit it if you don't need a startup script.
> - Ensure the zone you pick supports the `nvidia-tesla-a6000` GPU. Check [GPU availability](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/gpus#availability).

### 2. Using the REST API (curl)

#### Prerequisites
1. **OAuth 2.0 Access Token** – You can obtain one via `gcloud auth application-default print-access-token` or by using a service account key.
2. **Project ID** – Your GCP project identifier.
3. **Zone** – A zone that supports GPUs.

#### Example Request

```bash
PROJECT_ID="your-project-id"
ZONE="us-central1-a"
INSTANCE_NAME="rtx-a6000-ubuntu"
ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)

curl -X POST "https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/${PROJECT_ID}/zones/${ZONE}/instances" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
        "name": "'"${INSTANCE_NAME}"'",
        "machineType": "projects/'"${PROJECT_ID}"'/zones/'"${ZONE}"'/machineTypes/n1-standard-8",
        "disks": [
          {
            "boot": true,
            "autoDelete": true,
            "initializeParams": {
              "sourceImage": "projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/family/ubuntu-2004-lts",
              "diskSizeGb": 100,
              "diskType": "projects/'"${PROJECT_ID}"'/zones/'"${ZONE}"'/diskTypes/pd-ssd"
            }
          }
        ],
        "networkInterfaces": [
          {
            "network": "global/networks/default",
            "accessConfigs": [
              {"type": "ONE_TO_ONE_NAT", "name": "External NAT"}
            ]
          }
        ],
        "accelerators": [
          {
            "acceleratorCount": 1,
            "acceleratorType": "projects/'"${PROJECT_ID}"'/zones/'"${ZONE}"'/acceleratorTypes/nvidia-tesla-a6000"
          }
        ],
        "serviceAccounts": [
          {
            "email": "default",
            "scopes": [
              "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }'
```

> **Explanation of the JSON payload**
> - `name`: Name of the instance.
> - `machineType`: Full path to the machine type. Adjust the type (`n1-standard-8`) as needed.
> - `disks`: Boot disk configuration using the Ubuntu 20.04 LTS image family.
> - `networkInterfaces`: Connects the instance to the default VPC with external NAT.
> - `accelerators`: Adds one RTX A6000 GPU.
> - `serviceAccounts`: Grants the instance full Cloud Platform scope.

### Common Pitfalls
- **GPU Availability**: Not all zones support the RTX A6000. Use `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --filter='name:nvidia-tesla-a6000'` to check.
- **Billing**: GPU instances incur additional costs. Ensure billing is enabled for your project.
- **Quota**: Verify you have sufficient GPU quota in the selected zone.

---

**Happy computing!**

"},"filename":"create_gcp_instance_with_a6000.md"}
